verdict.rationale: Anytype supports fully local-only mode that disables the vendor backup node entirely (data stored locally, offline-first), and also offers a self-hostable sync backend via a team-maintained Docker image with network configuration, satisfying the story's requirement to avoid vendor cloud. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of self-hosting the Docker network config in production, and detail on multi-user self-hosted setup complexity/limitations.
